fixer.title: sessions: make opening and reloading large Agent Host chats responsive

cases.mechanism: Hot scrolling and rendering callers repeatedly invoked getItems(), and each invocation allocated and scanned the entire transcript.
cases.symptom: A 1,157-request chat spent about 3.6 seconds per scrollbar drag in getItems/isHiddenFromTranscript scans, contributing to renderer freezes.
cases.fixedBehavior: Returns one cached readonly visible-items array until a model or response change invalidates it, removing transcript-wide scans from repeated scroll/render queries.
cases.evidence: Before the PR, every getItems() call rebuilt the visible transcript by filtering the full _items array and computing pending/divider state. The changed implementation caches that result at RIGHT line 387 and invalidates it on model/view-model changes. The PR's traced large-chat scrollbar scenario reports getItems/isHiddenFromTranscript scanning falling from 3.6s per drag to under 1ms, and the added test verifies repeated reads perform one pending-request scan independent of call count.
